candidate.includes: PW36 combined RS32 small-M RQ and PW35 RTK router, plus optional EH65538/65539; old controls retained; cursor excluded

local_release_prerequisites: Exact registered pw38.stack.fullscope.01 result completes all three arms, all65normal+9exactofficial cases per arm and all30 paired/F1 shapes; no missing or filtered rows.
Both immediate actual terminal-output gates, current-X mutations, NaN output/float-workspace poison, immutable bytes, active reset/monotonic/dormant counter contracts and graph drain/reset pass.
Actual JIT EH/control PC/predicate/instruction/resource/physical gates pass; no caught build/gate failure is hidden by production fallback.
Root independently verifies actual guard/container/context/GPU cleanup and retains the source-bound raw artifacts; exit0 alone is not validation.
Independent full-result interpretation compares actual RS32 incumbent, PW36 parent and PW38 cumulative policy, including all regressions/uncertainty. No stitched minima or assumed additive gain.
Root explicitly releases an official check on the exact frozen file. A local H100 pass is not an official H200 pass or cold-prepare feasibility proof.

preserve_before_API: immutable source copy with expected SHA256
source manifest and source/driver/result independent reviews
attestation JSON with UTC timestamp, source size/hash, parent manifest hash and exact planned command
preserve_after_API: quota-before and quota-after JSON, last-known limits and actual live remaining counts
raw submit/check response and job id/mode/content_hash/payload_ref verbatim
normalized benchmark JSON, all30 actual profiles and full available preparation log
job-to-source attestation tying job id to the pre-upload local byte hash
official_snapshot_plan.identity_limit: Preserve server content_hash and payload_ref as opaque identifiers unless their algorithm/normalization is documented; do not equate them to local SHA256. Retain an actual uploaded payload copy if the service exposes one.

commands_notes: First create the snapshot directory and exact source copy; verify expected SHA and lint before any API call. Do not overwrite an existing attempt's logs; use a new attempt directory when needed.
The wrapper check command is quota-aware, prints the submitted id, waits, archives profiles and records the ordinary job ledger; it does not set the incumbent. It intentionally lacks --scored.
On a controller/SSH timeout use the recorded official job id to inspect/wait; never submit blindly again. A cached same-code result is not a fresh measurement; retain its actual id and mode.

Last documented pools are20checks/day and10scored/day, reset00:00UTC. These are planning context only; query actual limits/remaining quota after root release. Do not spend a scored slot merely because a quota reset is near.
official_acceptance_review: Verify job problem/mode/source association and successful official9/9 correctness plus all30 finite benchmark rows and actual profiles.

Check fresh H200 preparation and build behavior. Internal production guards remain240s; last documented prepare ceiling is300s and whole official run10minutes including compilation. Reconfirm current service limits at release. Warm local extension-cache preparation does not prove fresh judge feasibility.

Read actual H200 PREP/BAKE/PICK and skipped-budget/error lines, F1 before-pack/after-variants baselines and discarded warmup. Confirm RTK and small-M paths are genuinely selected where claimed; EH can remain unselected without falsifying source inclusion, but no EH speedup is then claimed.

Preserve all per-shape losses, load sums, official confidence intervals and preparation timing. Local bracketed F1, official calibrated paired timings and profiler durations are different contexts; do not subtract them into a latency decomposition.
Recompute speedup and score from this official job's own SGLang vector. Cross-job point differences alone do not prove a causal feature gain; statistical uncertainty remains visible.

scoring.formula: For each of six loads l, C_l=sum of the five official calibrated candidate times and B_l=sum of the same job's five SGLang times. Speedup=exp(sum_l(log(B_l/C_l))/6). score_us=4830.8/speedup.
scoring.CI_conversion: If official speedup CI=[lo,hi], score CI=[4830.8/hi,4830.8/lo].
prohibitions: 62*geomean(candidate load sums) is not the exact board score
No H100 timing substituted for H200 official timing
No uncompressed floor treated as an absolute lossless-compression bound

requirements: same frozen source bytes as checked; any edit creates a new version/check
fresh scored quota snapshot and archived response/id
independent correctness/rules/graph/lifetime/source review and evidence-aware comparison to actual best
retain official outcome whether gain, no gain, regression or invalid
scored_release_is_separate.promotion: No quota-driven automatic scoring or incumbent update. A passing check/exit0/full local result does not auto-promote. Root reviews the scored outcome before any separate incumbent action.
